title: Agentic Factory AIMS AI Transparency Register Schema
description: Standard schema for ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS) and EU AI Act transparency disclosures emitted by Agentic Factory.

rows.description: Inventory of AI models, prompt templates, tool allow-lists, and egress boundaries.

maker_id.description: Identifier of the agent maker role (e.g. maker-architect, maker-coder).

model_id.description: Specific foundation or fine-tuned model identifier.

provider.description: Hosting provider or local runtime (e.g. google, anthropic, openai, local-vllm).

prompt_template_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the immutable prompt template.

tool_allow_list.description: Exact list of tools permitted during execution.

egress_boundary.description: Network containment level enforced on the model invocation.

risk_tier.description: Risk classification per ISO 14971 / EU AI Act criteria.
